welcome.title: Welcome to the Beat Sheet Builder
welcome.description: Work through each beat to structure your novel. Don't worry about perfection—this is a planning tool. You can always revise.

tips.general: Focus on your protagonist's emotional journey, not just the plot events.
tips.openingImage: Think visually. What would this look like as the opening shot of a movie?
tips.theme: The theme is often stated as advice that the protagonist initially ignores.
tips.catalyst: This should happen around the 10% mark of your story.
tips.midpoint: The midpoint divides Act Two in half. It's a major turning point.
tips.allIsLost: Include a 'whiff of death'—someone dies, or something symbolically dies.
tips.finale: The five sub-beats ensure your climax has proper structure, not just action.

help.whatIsSTC: Save the Cat! is a storytelling methodology created by Blake Snyder. Originally for screenwriters, it's been adapted for novelists by Jessica Brody.
help.howToUse: Work through each beat in order, or jump around as inspiration strikes. The progress bar tracks your completion.
help.export: Export creates a plain text or markdown file you can use in your writing software.
